claims.statement: UTMB published its OpenEvidence clinical-workflow disclosure on September 22nd, 2026.
claims.text: UTMB published its OpenEvidence clinical-workflow disclosure on September 22nd, 2026.
claims.scope_note: Dated public disclosure of an existing deployment, not the go-live date.

claims.statement: UTMB says OpenEvidence is embedded in its electronic health record and reached through clinicians' UTMB credentials.
claims.text: UTMB says OpenEvidence is embedded in its electronic health record and reached through clinicians' UTMB credentials.
claims.quote: embedded within the UTMB electronic health record
claims.scope_note: Institutional description of the workflow, not an independently audited system diagram.

claims.statement: UTMB says clinicians can ask clinical questions in natural language and receive AI answers with citations to medical literature and guidelines.
claims.text: UTMB says clinicians can ask clinical questions in natural language and receive AI answers with citations to medical literature and guidelines.
claims.scope_note: A citation is not an independent check of the answer's accuracy.

claims.statement: UTMB reports that more than half its clinicians actively use OpenEvidence for clinical decision support.
claims.text: UTMB reports that more than half its clinicians actively use OpenEvidence for clinical decision support.
claims.quote: more than half of UTMB clinicians
claims.scope_note: Self-reported use; no denominator, usage period or independent audit is supplied.

claims.statement: UTMB says it will continue evaluating use, clinician experience and opportunities to improve evidence delivery at the point of care.
claims.text: UTMB says it will continue evaluating use, clinician experience and opportunities to improve evidence delivery at the point of care.
claims.scope_note: The complete release gives no measured patient outcome or independent answer-accuracy result.

claims.statement: UTMB's September release says the integration went live in March.
claims.text: UTMB's September release says the integration went live in March.
claims.quote: went live at UTMB in March
claims.scope_note: The May bulletin gives a separate clinician availability date; neither source explains the rollout sequence.

claims.statement: UTMB's May clinician bulletin says Epic enhancements including OpenEvidence were available effective April 21st, 2026.
claims.text: UTMB's May clinician bulletin says Epic enhancements including OpenEvidence were available effective April 21st, 2026.
claims.scope_note: The September release separately says the integration went live in March. No public rollout sequence is established.

claims.statement: A UTMB clinician bulletin describes OpenEvidence use in patient-specific contexts.
claims.text: A UTMB clinician bulletin describes OpenEvidence use in patient-specific contexts.
claims.scope_note: The bulletin states this use; it does not publish a technical privacy audit.

rejected: No source here measures a diagnosis, patient outcome, time saving or answer accuracy gain.
The two UTMB pages do not reconcile March go-live with April 21st clinician availability.
The pages describe privacy and security claims but provide no independent audit.
The August Epic cloud migration is a separate change with no documented causal link to this tool.
